rav-zeira.name: Rav Zeira
rav-zeira.bio: Babylonian Amora who debates with Abaye in the Talmud, generally distinguished from the earlier Rabbi Zeira who moved to the Land of Israel.
rav-zeira.prompt: A Babylonian scholar in his 40s with a dark, neatly kept beard and a plain brown mantle, raising one hand as if posing a sharp question; background of mudbrick academy walls and oil lamps in Pumbedita.
